note: typed_entity_ui adds a read-only admin explorer for Typed Entity. Configure route typed_entity_ui.explore -> /admin/config/development/typed-entity (details route typed_entity_ui.details -> .../{typed_entity_id}). Single permission 'explore typed entity classes' gates both. No config entities, no plugins, no Drush; provides theme hooks php_class_info/class_with_variants/php_class_summary and one State flag typed_entity_ui.hide_video_thumbnail (removed on uninstall). Baseline: the submodule is disabled. Medium cases enable it and read the live routing (path, permission); hard cases build real state (enable the module so its explorer route exists; grant the explore permission to a role te_ui_role) verified against the live router / role config. cleanup uninstalls the submodule (and deletes te_ui_role) to restore baseline.

evals.prompt: After enabling the Typed Entity UI submodule, at what admin URL path do you find the 'Explore Typed Entity' page?
evals.expected_output: The explorer is at /admin/config/development/typed-entity (route typed_entity_ui.explore, under Configuration > Development).

evals.prompt: Which permission does the typed_entity_ui module define to control access to its Typed Entity explorer pages?
evals.expected_output: The single permission 'explore typed entity classes' (title 'Explore typed entity classes') gates both the explore and details routes.

evals.prompt: What does the Typed Entity UI explorer let a developer inspect for a chosen entity type and bundle?
evals.expected_output: It shows the typed repository for the entity-type/bundle pair, its wrapper and renderer ClassWithVariants (fallback + variants), and a reflection-based summary of each class (namespace, parent class, interfaces, doc comment, source file, and the reconstructed #[TypedRepository] attribute).

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site the Typed Entity UI is enabled. Inspect the site's routing and give the URL path registered for the Typed Entity explorer route named typed_entity_ui.explore.
evals.expected_output: The route typed_entity_ui.explore has path /admin/config/development/typed-entity. Read it via \Drupal::service('router.route_provider')->getRouteByName('typed_entity_ui.explore')->getPath().

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site the Typed Entity UI is enabled. Inspect the routing and state which permission protects the Typed Entity explorer route (typed_entity_ui.explore).
evals.expected_output: The route's _permission requirement is 'explore typed entity classes'. Read it via \Drupal::service('router.route_provider')->getRouteByName('typed_entity_ui.explore')->getRequirement('_permission').

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the Typed Entity class explorer available by enabling the Typed Entity UI module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable typed_entity_ui (e.g. `drush en typed_entity_ui -y`). Afterwards the module is installed and its explorer route typed_entity_ui.explore (path /admin/config/development/typed-entity) exists.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Typed Entity UI module is enabled and a role with machine name 'te_ui_role' exists. Grant that role permission to use the Typed Entity explorer. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the 'explore typed entity classes' permission to the te_ui_role role, e.g. `drush role:perm:add te_ui_role 'explore typed entity classes'` or by adding it to the role's permissions in user.role.te_ui_role. Result: Role::load('te_ui_role')->hasPermission('explore typed entity classes') is TRUE.
